title: Vardi
desc: Constable Bhagwan is killed by Lalchand, a gangster. Years later, Bhagwan's son Ajay, along with his father's close associate Inspector Verma, tries to capture Lalchand and bring him to justice.

desc: Jeeva, a young man, turns to professional killing after losing his family and girlfriend, seeking vengeance and meaning as he navigates a perilous path.

title: Tumse Achcha Kaun Hai
desc: A talented singer struggles with unrequited love but finds unexpected support from a wealthy tycoon's daughter, leading to new opportunities and a journey of self-discovery.

title: Baaghi 3
desc: Ronnie, deeply connected to his policeman brother Vikram, embarks on a daring mission to rescue him after Vikram is kidnapped in Syria during a dangerous operation.

title: Jai Maa Vaishno Devi
desc: A childless couple, are devotees of Maa Vaishno Devi.When demon destroys a ritual organised by them, the goddess slays the demon and blesses the couple.
